faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar E-Pace P300e use?
faqLeft.a: The E-Pace P300e uses the Ingenium AJ150 - a 1.5-litre three-cylinder petrol engine paired with an electric motor. It's Jaguar's plug-in hybrid powertrain for the E-Pace range.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar E-Pace P300e engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,000. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my E-Pace P300e?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the Ingenium AJ150 PHEV specification before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ingenium AJ150 E-Pace P300e engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We service it to the same standard as our other Ingenium rebuilds.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used E-Pace P300e engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my E-Pace P300e if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an E-Pace P300e engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most E-Pace P300e owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
